attempts.why: Dark theme --fg was #222 (~rgb 34,34,34) on --bg #111 (~rgb 17,17,17) making all var(--fg) text effectively invisible/low-contrast on dark background at viewport.

selfVerify.reason: Dark theme --fg now rgb(238,238,238) (#EEE) on --bg rgb(17,17,17) (#111) instead of #222 on #111, restoring WCAG-level contrast. All var(--fg) elements (header, hero h1 #h1, lede, probe, cards, pricing #pricing, form fields, footer) render light-on-dark and are visible at 1200x800. No horizontal overflow (docScrollWidth=1200 matches viewport), no clipping/overlap, hidden components remain display:none.
